title: Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)
description: <h1>Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)</h1> <h2><strong>About Stripe</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.</li> <li>Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.</li> <li>Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.</li> <li>Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation</li> <li>Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.</li> <li>Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process</li> <li>Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal. You are naturally curious and analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions.</p> <h3>Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Fluent in German</li> <li>7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance</li> <li>Experience moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition</li> <li>Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment</li> <li>Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies</li> <li>Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements and cost models</li> <li>Superior verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Highly curious with a strong interest in technology&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>Preferred requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/Software company</li> <li>Experience in fintech/payments is a plus, but not prerequisite</li> </ul> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

B. Mediengestaltung).</li> <li><strong>Kommunikations- &amp; Sprachkompetenz:</strong> Du bewegst dich stilsicher und verhandlungssicher in deutscher sowie englischer Sprache (in Wort und Schrift).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Darüber hinaus bist du:</strong> <strong>#kreativ #lösungsorientiert #eigeninitiativ #stressresistent</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln&nbsp;und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br>&nbsp;<br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen. #LI-Promoted (ID:13706)</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.   Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.  WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale. Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation. You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows. WHAT YOU'LL DO  Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms  Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives  Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain  WHAT YOU'LL NEED 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments  Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling.  Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2. Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)  Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL)  Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions. In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud. WHY CATAPULT?  We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.  We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance. Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.   We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!  Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.   Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability

title: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
description: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote Level: Senior to lead Location: Remote, CET overlap Contract: Full time, long term About us We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft. The project Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same. Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this. About the role We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer. You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them. The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. raw.description:
3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote

  • Level: Senior to lead

  • Location: Remote, CET overlap

  • Contract: Full time, long term

About us

We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft.

The project

Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same.

Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this.

About the role

We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer.

You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them.

The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team.

You report to the Art Director.

What you will do

Environment art

  • Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit.

  • Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts.

  • Build modular kits that can be reused across levels.

  • Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction.

Level design

  • Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared.

  • Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine.

  • Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results.

  • Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression.

  • Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines.

What we are looking for

  • Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development.

  • Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish.

  • Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts.

  • A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final.

  • Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity.

  • Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it.

  • Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials.

  • Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning.

  • Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team.

  • Comfortable working in English every day, in meetings (mostly on camera) and in writing. It does not need to be perfect.

Nice to have

  • 3D character or gameplay animation.

  • 3D character modelling.

  • Technical art or VFX.

  • Experience with GitHub or Fork.

  • Experience with player-built levels, or tools for game creators.

  • Experience in a small team where you covered more than one role.

What we offer

  • A fully remote team with flexible working.

  • Trust to manage your own time. We do not use timesheets.

  • Ownership of the game’s spaces, from first layout to final.

  • A small team where people help each other.

Working setup

  • Fully remote. Your working day needs to overlap with CET.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract. It is business to business.

  • We would like you to start as soon as you are available.

What this role is not

  • Not a lead game designer role. Our Creative Director sets the direction of the game.

  • Not an art-only or design-only role. You will do both.

How to apply

Apply through the link; a few short questions are part of the application form. If we shortlist you, the next step is interviews, and for final candidates an unpaid planning task of about two hours at an agreed time, with no modelling or texturing. We reply to everyone at every step.

We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day. TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations. About the Role As the Lead Instructor, EMEA , you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. Cyber and OSINT tradecraft is the complement: you will show investigators how to pair it with on-chain tracing to build a complete case. EMEA is a region where we win by showing up. title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, DashOS EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.</p> <p>In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.</p> <p>Our Strategy &amp; Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h2> <p>As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.</p> <p><strong>Day-to-day in this role you'll:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the revenue tracking infrastructure:</strong> own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place</li> <li><strong>Run the commercial operating cadence,</strong> including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership</li> <li><strong>Own sales planning across markets:</strong> set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals</li> <li><strong>Turn sales performance data into action</strong> by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on</li> <li><strong>Design and roll out incentive systems,</strong> including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue</li> <li><strong>Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion,</strong> so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side</li> <li><strong>Automate and scale with AI,</strong> removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our humble expectations</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy &amp; Operations or a similar commercial role,</strong> ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.</li> <li><strong>A track record in sales planning:</strong> quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on with data and systems.</strong> You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing incentive models,</strong> variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.</li> <li><strong>A builder and generalist</strong> who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders,</strong> able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.</li> <li><strong>Strong understanding of distinct sales motions,</strong> including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Bonus:</strong> experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join us</strong></h2> <p>You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Make a visible impact every day,</strong> directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.</li> <li><strong>Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment,</strong> with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.</li> <li><strong>Build a career, not just a role,</strong> as DashOS grows across EMEA.</li> <li><strong>Deliver together</strong> in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/GoL541_xj9w" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.</span></p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Product Analytics Team Lead
description: HEY THERE You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half. Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else. You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for. Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide! This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK. YOUR MISSION Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll: Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions YOUR PROFILE You'll feel at home here if: You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it Bonus points for: Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play) A strong statistics background Dagster or Airflow for scheduling Data catalogues like DataHub OUR CORE TECH STACK Here's what we run in production: Warehouse: Snowflake Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster Experimentation: GrowthBook Self-service analytics: Omni ML workflows: Prefect GenAI: Claude If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back. WHY US? An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back! A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION At Yazio, we believe that diversity fuels innovation. raw.title: Product Analytics Team Lead
raw.description:
HEY THERE

You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half.

Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else.

You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for.

Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK.

YOUR MISSION

Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll:

  • Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next

  • Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on

  • Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up

  • Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it

  • Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before

  • Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool

  • Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions

YOUR PROFILE

You'll feel at home here if:

  • You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course

  • You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself

  • Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways

  • You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through

  • You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data

  • When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play)

  • A strong statistics background

  • Dagster or Airflow for scheduling

  • Data catalogues like DataHub

 

OUR CORE TECH STACK

Here's what we run in production:

  • Warehouse: Snowflake

  • Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster

  • Experimentation: GrowthBook

  • Self-service analytics: Omni

  • ML workflows: Prefect

  • GenAI: Claude

If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space, or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours - no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change - short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

  • A team culture where ambition and balance go hand in hand, supported by strong connections - from our fully covered company retreat to team meetups and virtual coffee breaks

  • Tools and support to do your best work: MacBook, monitor, and €1,000 annual learning budget, plus regular feedback and career development

  • A truly international team with English as our company language and a shared commitment to growth and well-being - supported by Sunday Supplements and Nilo Health

AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team.

The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem.

Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

  • Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost.

  • Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up.

  • Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building.

  • Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback.

  • Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality.

  • Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down.

  • Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next.

Inspire us by

  • Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus.

  • Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them.

  • Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus.

  • End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality.

  • Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders.

  • Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus.

What we offer

title: Associate Operations Manager für das Altersvorsorgedepot (f/m/d)
description: Bei Upvest verfolgen wir die Mission, Investieren so einfach zu machen wie Geldausgeben. Upvest befähigt Unternehmen, eine breite Palette an Anlageprodukten anzubieten und ihren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Erlebnis im Bereich Kapitalmarktinvestments und Altersvorsorge zu ermöglichen. Die Upvest Investment API ist einfach zu integrieren, sodass Fintechs und Finanzinstitute Ressourcen sparen und sich voll auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren können. Wir sind stolz darauf, mit Europas führenden Fintechs und Finanzinstituten wie DKB, Revolut, N26 und Raisin zusammenzuarbeiten. Upvest wurde 2017 von Martin Kassing gegründet und vereint heute über 270 talentierte Fachkräfte aus mehr als 70 Nationen. Upvest wird durch ein Gesamtinvestment von 280 Mio. € von erstklassigen Investoren unterstützt, darunter BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures sowie Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital und Motive. Unsere jüngste Finanzierungsrunde über 110 Mio. € im März 2026 – angeführt von Sapphire und Tencent – dient als massiver Katalysator für unser Wachstum und ermöglicht es uns, ein erstklassiges Investment-Erlebnis zu bieten. Revolutioniere die Altersvorsorge in Deutschland Wir suchen einen Associate Operations Manager (f/m/d) rund um das Thema Altersvorsorgedepot, der die operativen Prozesse für diesen zentralen Geschäftsbereich durchführt. Deine Aufgaben: Verantwortung und Durchführung von Übertragungen, Zulagenmanagement, Bonusanträgen sowie der steuerlichen Abwicklung und dem Edge-Case-Handling unter strikter Einhaltung von SLAs und KPIs. Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung zum zentralen Fachexperten für alle Themen des operativen Tagesgeschäfts. Fachliche Unterstützung der Kundenteams bei der Betreuung ihrer Endnutzer sowie Beantwortung komplexer Fragestellungen rund um die Altersvorsorge. Laufende Optimierung der Arbeitsabläufe durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI, Automatisierungstools und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit. Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs sowie proaktive Adressierung von Risiken unter strikter Beachtung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und interner Richtlinien. Was Du mitbringst: Großes Interesse an der Arbeit mit künstlicher Intelligenz und der aktiven Nutzung von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag. Zuverlässigkeit und Belastbarkeit auch in Zeiten hohen Arbeitsaufkommens sowie ein gewissenhaftes Terminmanagement. Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative verbunden mit einer ausgeprägten Teamfähigkeit. Von Vorteil ist: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung mit tiefem fachlichem Fokus auf die Riester-Rente sowie die damit verbundenen operativen Prozesse. Fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenanalyse und Prozessoptimierung unter Einsatz von Visualisierungstools sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL, Python oder Workflow-Automatisierung (z. B. n8n). Praktische Erfahrung im produktiven Umgang mit Large Language Models (wie Claude) oder vergleichbaren KI-gestützten Lösungen. Wie wir in dich investieren: Arbeit mit Mehrwert: Wir bauen die Infrastruktur, die die Zukunft des Investierens in Europa prägen wird. Unsere Arbeit ist komplex, ambitioniert und sinnstiftend. Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien und schaffst etwas völlig Neues - ohne Legacy-Systeme, ohne Grenzen. Wohlbefinden: Erhole dich mit 30 Tagen Jahresurlaub und profitiere von Sport- und Gesundheitsbenefits für einen aktiven Lebensstil. Zusätzlich hast du Zugang zu vertraulichem, professionellem Coaching und kannst bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr remote aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Nach jeweils vier Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit erhältst du außerdem UpRest, ein voll bezahltes Sabbatical von einem Monat. Weiterentwicklung: Wachstum liegt in unserer DNA. Jede:r Upvenger verfügt über ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und die Freiheit, selbst zu entscheiden, wie es eingesetzt wird. Vergütung & Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Wir sind überzeugt, dass alle Upvenger zu unserem Erfolg beitragen. Deshalb bieten wir ein wettbewerbsfähiges, überdurchschnittliches Gehalt sowie eine Teilnahme an unserem Mitarbeiter:innen-Beteiligungsprogramm. Team-Events & Feiern: Nimm an unternehmensweiten Events wie UpFest, Team-Dinners, Offsites oder unserer Holiday Party teil, um dich zu vernetzen und gemeinsame Erfolge zu feiern. Inklusion: Wir fördern eine Kultur, in der sich alle zugehörig fühlen und entfalten können. Unsere Employee Resource Groups stärken Vielfalt, Inklusion und Vernetzung, zum Beispiel durch Upfem für unsere weiblichen Upvenger oder UpVergent, das Unterstützung für neurodivergente Upvengers und Allies anbietet. Unsere Werte: Make it easy for others. Wir vereinfachen Komplexes und handeln stets mit den besten Absichten. Own the outcome. Wir sind proaktiv, schnell und entscheidungsstark. Dabei zählt für uns Fortschritt mehr als Perfektion. Rise to the challenge. Wir denken groß und gehen über Grenzen hinaus. Neugier treibt uns an, wir lernen kontinuierlich und feiern Erfolge gemeinsam. Tell the story. Wir starten mit dem Warum - ein gemeinsame Mission gibt Richtung. Transparenz und Wissensaustausch helfen uns, andere zu befähigen und zu inspirieren. Upvest ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. Team's mission

Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do.

Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it.

  • Work in weekly cycles with bi-weekly retrospectives to prioritize high-quality, high-frequency shipping.

  • True end-to-end ownership across containers, CI/CD pipelines, and relational data modeling.

  • A working understanding of event-driven architectures.

  • Experience building operational or back-office tooling for business users.

  • Experience with identity platforms such as Auth0, or with multi-tenant isolation.

  • Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

Our software platform uses artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and edge computing to provide real-time situational awareness for air, land, and sea domains, enabling rapid decisions at machine speed. Our cutting-edge technology is utilized by customers across the defense, national security, government, marine, and critical infrastructure protection markets worldwide.

Software engineers at Walaris are at the core of our company, tackling complex and mission-critical technical challenges with the latest technologies. They integrate real-time machine learning and image processing systems and are constantly designing innovative software solutions to provide best in class capabilities. Working in cross-functional, international teams, our engineers consistently strive to exceed customer expectations.

For our office in Nuremberg, we are looking for a C2 Software Engineer (m/f/d) starting in April 2027.

Responsibilities

  • Develop command-and-control (C2) systems to meet operational and technical requirements derived from strategic company objectives
  • Integrate Walaris software and technology into military and security systems to add autonomous capabilities and boost overall system performance
  • Develop software solutions that improve system reliability, deployment velocity, and developer experience
  • Own and deliver complex features end-to-end across the full stack, from web-based frontend interfaces through distributed backend services and technical design through production deployment iteration
  • Ensure compliance with relevant military safety and quality standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure that requirements from R&D, sales, and product management are fully integrated and effectively addressed throughout the development process

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional experience in the development of complex software systems with strong proficiency in Rust, C++, or Python
  • Experience with distributed systems and system integration
  • Hands-on experience with multithreading and concurrency, asynchronous and distributed systems, containerized architectures (e.g., Docker-based environments), messaging systems (e.g., ZeroMQ, DDS, NATS, or similar), and performance optimization and system tuning
  • Expertise in software development on Linux platforms
  • Solid understanding of networking protocols and communication mechanisms, including TCP/IP, UDP, and inter-process communication (IPC)
  • Experience designing and working with REST APIs
  • Knowledge of low-latency communication systems
  • Fluent in English and German

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with high-availability and fault-tolerant systems
  • Understanding of real-time and deterministic system requirements
  • Experience with sensor integration and multi-modal sensor fusion in event-driven systems
  • Background in geospatial data systems (GIS/geoinformatics) or processing of time-series data
  • Experience building software according to DALs and standards like DO-278, DO-178, or ASIL
  • Familiarity with NATO standards like SAPIENT, STANAG 4586, etc.

Benefits

Join our mission and become part of an innovative, dynamic team! At Walaris, you’ll play a vital role in saving lives and safeguarding local and national security by harnessing the power of cutting-edge technologies. This is your chance to break new ground and take on meaningful responsibility as you help develop and deploy industry-defining solutions.

We offer creative freedom, competitive compensation, and a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions truly matter.

If you’re ready to make an impact, we invite you to apply by submitting your cover letter, resume, and transcript through our online application form.

title: Growth Associate - MUC - FT - Lisa
description: Growth Associate (Munich) AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate. For decades, procurement teams have relied on spreadsheets, emails and fragmented processes to manage billions in spend. As AI agents take over increasingly complex workflows, that’s about to change. As a Growth Associate, you open the first door into these accounts. You’re not just booking meetings: you’re creating the first impression of Lio. You’re the first conversation a CPO has with Lio, and you’re on the fast track to closing these deals yourself. And you don’t just run the playbook, you help write it: you own projects that make our whole go-to-market engine faster and smarter. Location: Munich, in office WHAT YOU’LL DO Build pipeline Find the right people in target accounts and start conversations that matter to them, through outbound and inbound Research accounts properly and write outreach that targets each persona’s real pain Build creative outreach strategies across email, LinkedIn and phone, and test what actually gets a CPO to respond Run qualification and hand opportunities to our AEs with the context they need to win Improve the playbook Design and test new outbound plays (signals, sequences, events) and turn what works into the team’s playbook Own side projects that move go-to-market forward, whether it’s a new channel, a tooling setup or helping us hire Share what you hear from customers with Product and Marketing, and help shape our messaging WHO YOU ARE 1-3 years of experience in GTM: SDR, sales, business development or growth, or a related start in VC, consulting or a founder’s office Ownership by default: you don’t wait for instructions or permission, you make things happen Builder mindset: when you see a process that’s slow or broken, you fix it, and you love using AI and new tools to do it Persistence and consistency: a first “no” is where it starts, not where it ends. You also read the room and learn where to push and where to give space. Clear communication, so you build trust with senior stakeholders quickly and know how to create excitement, whether you’re talking to a Fortune 500 executive or a buyer on the factory floor Attention to detail and ownership of your pipeline, from first touch to handoff You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and adapt quickly to AI-driven change YOUR PATH This is where your GTM journey starts. Hit your targets, and within about 12 months you’re an AE owning complex enterprise deals end to end, or you grow into a growth role that owns and scales how we generate pipeline. Along the way, you gain extensive GTM experience in scaling a startup in a high-paced environment. WHY JOIN US Silicon Valley DNA, built in Europe: backed by a16z, with the same ambition, speed and culture, in Munich Exposure from day one to Fortune 500 companies and C-level procurement leaders running large-scale transformations A team that moves fast, values impact and gives you room to grow. No endless approval processes, no politics, no waiting for permission. Joining early: the category is still being defined and the playbook is still being written Competitive salary plus equity Have questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Lisa . To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next.

You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers.

  • Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations.

  • Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout.

  • Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout.

  • Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand.

  • Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast.

  • Bring the market back into Heidi: Share clear evidence about why customers buy, what slows adoption and where product improvements or localisation could unlock growth. Work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and the wider DACH team.

 

What you'll need

  • A proven record of selling and closing: You’ve personally owned a revenue target and can explain the deals you originated, how you won them and the results you delivered. Experience in B2B software or a similarly complex commercial environment is particularly relevant.

  • Strong sales craft: You know how to run discovery, build a compelling business case, develop champions and navigate opportunities involving several stakeholders. You can earn credibility with both a clinician and a CFO.

  • The ability to create opportunities: You’ve built pipeline through your own efforts and know how to turn an account list or a promising introduction into meaningful commercial progress.

  • A generalist’s range and judgement: You enjoy work beyond the immediate deal: testing a channel, developing a partnership, organising a customer session or solving a problem that is holding growth back. You can balance that breadth with delivering your number.

  • Independence and pace: You create structure when the playbook is still being written, make sensible decisions with incomplete information and follow through without being chased.

  • Fluent German and strong English: You can lead nuanced commercial conversations in German and work effectively with a global team.

  • Curiosity about healthcare and AI: You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and use AI thoughtfully in your own work. You’re open to feedback and willing to change your approach when the evidence changes.

Particularly useful experience

  • Being an early AE or helping grow a new territory at a scaling company.

  • Selling into DACH healthcare or another complex, regulated market.

  • Building partnerships or turning individual product usage into larger organisational deals.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

title: Social Content Manager
description: Bei Jellyfish glauben wir an die Kraft vielfältiger Perspektiven und an eine inklusive Zusammenarbeit. Wir begrüßen Menschen, die in diversen, kollaborativen Teams über sich hinauswachsen und die individuellen Sichtweisen anderer schätzen. Jellyfish ist eine globale Digital Marketing Agentur – eine einzigartige Verbindung aus Tech-Enthusiast:innen, kreativen Köpfen sowie Media- und Daten-Expert:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel vereint: unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer digitalen Reise weiterzubringen. Unser Anspruch, unterschiedliche Blickwinkel aktiv einzubinden, ist der Treibstoff für unsere innovativen Lösungen und Strategien. Wir hinterfragen den Status quo, denken Media-Aktivierung neu und entwickeln Stories mit Wirkkraft, für unsere internationalen Kund:innen und deren Zielgruppen. Gestalte mit uns eine Zukunft, in der berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Stellenbeschreibung Du berichtest direkt an den Senior Social Content Manager und sorgst vom ersten Tag an für spürbaren Impact in unserer paneuropäischen Social-Creative-Abteilung. Wir sind stolz auf unsere langjährigen Partnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Größen und auf unsere Arbeit, die Kultur prägt und sich von der Masse abhebt. Von unserem Berliner Hub aus – mit echter hybrider Flexibilität – treibst du Social-First-Storytelling und kulturelle Relevanz für eine führende Streaming-Marke auf dem deutschen Markt voran. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem agilen Netzwerk aus Editor:innen, Designer:innen und Integrated Producer:innen in Berlin, London, Paris und Madrid steuerst du alles – von dynamischen Vertical Videos (TikTok und Instagram) über Creator-Kooperationen bis hin zur Live-Begleitung von Events vor Ort. Mit echtem kreativen Gestaltungsspielraum und einer offenen, kollegialen Unternehmenskultur bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem mutige Ideen wachsen können. Deine Aufgaben Social Account Management Du arbeitest direkt mit einem großen Entertainment-Streaming-Kunden zusammen, pitchst eigene Kreativkonzepte und stimmst strategische Ziele gemeinsam ab. Du entwickelst herausragende Social-Aktivierungen für große Film- und Serienstarts sowie für saisonale und kulturelle Highlights. Du adaptierst globale Kampagnen-Assets und Toolkits für den deutschen Markt und passt Botschaften an, sodass diese lokale kulturelle Nuancen treffen. Du verantwortest die Social-First-Begleitung bei Live-Events, Marketing-Shoots und Presseveranstaltungen und briefst und leitest Talente vor Ort souverän an. Du übernimmst das gesamte kreative Copywriting über alle Formate hinweg – von Videoskripten und Interviewfragen bis hin zu In-Asset-Texten und plattformgerechten Captions. Du pflegst plattformübergreifende Redaktionspläne und koordinierst die tägliche Planung und Veröffentlichung freigegebener Inhalte auf allen organischen Kanälen. Social Media Expertise Du behältst Plattform-Updates, neue Nutzungsgewohnheiten und Popkultur-Trends in Echtzeit im Blick, um proaktiv reaktiven, kulturell relevanten Content zu pitchen. Du beobachtest Community-Stimmen sowie Performance-Daten nach dem Launch und übersetzt Analysen in fundierte Kampagnen-Debriefs, Abschlussberichte und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kund:innen. Projektmanagement Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Design, Redaktion und Integrated Production zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Assets entlang Briefing, pünktlich und exakt im Einklang mit den Markenrichtlinien der Kund:innen geliefert werden. Du sorgst für reibungslose interne Produktionsabläufe, indem du verlässliche Zeitpläne erstellst und pflegst, Feedbackschleifen mit Kund:innen steuerst und Freigabeprozesse vom Briefing bis zum finalen Sign-off souverän begleitest. Dein Profil Deutsch auf C2- oder Muttersprachniveau mit einem sicheren Gespür für Copywriting, das auf Social-Media-Kanäle und den jeweiligen Tone of Voice der Marke zugeschnitten ist. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch im Arbeitsalltag. Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption, dem Scripting und der Produktion von Social Content auf nationalem Kampagnenniveau. Sicherer Umgang mit TikTok, Meta, YouTube und X sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Publishing- und Management-Tools wie der Meta Business Suite oder Sprinklr. Erfahrung im Community Management sowie ein intuitives Verständnis für Audience Engagement, Tone of Voice von Marken und plattformtypische Kommunikation. Tiefes Eintauchen in die deutsche Jugendkultur, Entertainment-Trends und Online-Fandoms – verbunden mit dem Talent, spontane Internet-Momente in mitreißenden Content zu verwandeln. Starke, teamorientierte Kommunikation über alle Touchpoints hinweg (vom täglichen Chat bis hin zu formellen Kundencalls und Präsentationen) sowie ein Händchen dafür, langfristiges Vertrauen und partnerschaftliche Beziehungen aufzubauen. Bei Herausforderungen holst du die richtigen Leute an einen Tisch, wägst verschiedene Optionen ab und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Hinweis: Wir legen mehr Wert auf Fähigkeiten, Fachwissen und persönliche Eigenschaften als auf langjährige Berufserfahrung oder klassische Studienabschlüsse. Wenn du Teil unseres kooperativen Teams werden möchtest, bewirb dich noch heute mit deinem Lebenslauf auf Englisch . Weitere Infos Werde Teil von Jellyfish und erlebe ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Weiterentwicklung Priorität hat, deine Erfolge gefeiert werden und du deinen Arbeitsalltag so gestalten kannst, wie es am besten zu dir passt. 💫 Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite bis zu 60 % deiner Zeit remote und gestalte deinen Arbeitstag dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten frei zwischen 8:00 und 18:30 Uhr. 📈 Weiterbildung nach deinen Vorstellungen: Sammle jeden Monat einen bezahlten Weiterbildungstag (2 Stunden pro Woche) für deine persönliche Entwicklung und nutze vollen Zugriff auf Jellyfish Learn. Leider häufen sich aktuell Fälle, in denen sich gefälschte Recruiter:innen als Jellyfish ausgeben und unseren Markennamen unrechtmäßig verwenden. Wenn du dir unsicher bist, ob eine E-Mail mit einem Jobangebot wirklich von Jellyfish stammt, oder wenn du einen Betrugsversuch vermutest, melde dies bitte an • €45K – €50K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
