Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build, assemble and modify prototypes, experimental hardware, custom tooling and development rigs for engineering and special projects across the programme.

  • Turn engineering drawings, models, and sketches into practical hardware. Clarify missing requirements and agree the build approach with the responsible engineer before committing to uncertain or irreversible steps.

  • Fabricate and adapt components using fitting, cutting, drilling, soldering, bonding and assembly techniques within your competence. Coordinate specialist machining, welding or other work when needed.

  • Identify buildability issues early, including tolerance stacks, inaccessible fasteners, component fit and assembly sequence, and provide practical feedback to the design team.

  • Prepare and run development trials, including winding, joining, insulation and impregnation trials as assigned. Install instrumentation, commission rigs with engineers, take measurements and record what changed and what happened.

  • Investigate unexpected behaviour, propose practical fixes and work through build-test-modify iterations with engineers.

  • Organise the practical delivery of assigned projects: source small parts and consumables through agreed purchasing routes, arrange tools and build activities, and keep the workshop ready for use. Communicate progress, blockers and changing priorities to the lead technician.

  • Keep clear as-built records, annotated drawings, photographs, settings and trial observations so another technician can reproduce the work and understand each modification.

  • Transfer proven prototypes and methods to manufacturing or routine testing through initial work instructions, tooling, assembly sequences, training and technical handovers.

  • Work with engineers to identify hazards and establish the necessary risk assessments and controls before starting work on unproven hardware.

     

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronic or related engineering work, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience building, modifying and troubleshooting mechanical or electromechanical hardware in a workshop, laboratory, development or advanced manufacturing environment.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and 3D models, with working familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and practical measurement skills.

  • Confident hand-tool and workshop skills, sound fabrication and assembly judgement, and a willingness to develop unfamiliar techniques.

  • Resourcefulness with incomplete information: you investigate, ask useful questions, find suitable parts and propose a practical next step while keeping the engineering objective clear.

  • Sound judgement about technical uncertainty, safety and when a build or design change requires engineering review before proceeding.

  • The ability to organise work, adapt to agreed priority changes and document configurations and findings clearly.

  • Working English for technical discussions, drawings, instructions and build records.

Nice to have

  • Specialist fabrication skills such as manual or CNC machining, sheet-metal work, welding, brazing or additive manufacturing.

  • Experience creating or modifying simple parts and fixtures in CATIA, SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or similar CAD tools.

  • Experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition, electrical wiring, vacuum, cryogenics or superconducting hardware.

  • Experience with composites, resins, vacuum bagging, insulation or impregnation.

  • Experience taking first-of-a-kind hardware or a prototype process through to repeatable manufacturing and technical handover.

  • German language skills.

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Maintain, troubleshoot and repair machinery across our magnet factory,keeping equipment safe, accurate and available.

  • Carry out preventive maintenance, inspections and repairs on mechanical, electromechanical and pneumatic systems.

  • Diagnose breakdowns, intermittent faults and undocumented failures. Resolve the root cause and verify safe operation before returning equipment to service.

  • Assemble, install, align, and commission new equipment.

  • Support factory and site acceptance tests, installation checks.

  • Work with multiple teams to distinguish machine faults from setup, material, process or measurement problems.

  • Work with controls and manufacturing engineering to tune equipment, including winding tension, motion, vacuum and thermal profiles, within approved process limits.

  • Identify wear early, flag long-lead items and communicate to the lead technician.

  • Record failure modes, downtime, repairs, parts used and equipment modifications.

  • Apply lockout/tagout, safe isolation, stored-energy controls and controlled restart procedures.

  • Provide clear handovers on equipment condition, outstanding faults and any operating restrictions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in industrial maintenance, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production or process equipment.

  • Strong electrical and mechanical diagnostic skills.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, equipment manuals and electrical or pneumatic schematics, and practical familiarity with mechanisms, pneumatics, drives and sensors.

  • Confidence using workshop tools and measuring equipment to strip, rebuild, align and inspect machine components accurately.

  • A disciplined approach to electrical and machine safety, safe isolation and stored energy, with sound judgement about when specialist support is required.

  • The ability to organise assigned work independently, keep reliable records and adapt as equipment and processes develop.

  • Working English for understanding technical instructions, recording work and communicating with technicians, engineers and suppliers.

Nice to have

  • Experience with reel-to-reel machinery, tension control, precision motion, or cable and conductor handling.

  • Experience diagnosing programmable logic controller (PLC) systems beyond the operator screen, including Beckhoff/TwinCAT or comparable controls.

  • Experience commissioning custom machinery, a new cell or a new production line, including factory or site acceptance testing.

  • Hydraulic, vacuum, cryogenic or high-voltage equipment experience; an electrical qualification such as Elektrofachkraft.

  • Experience with computerised maintenance management systems (CMMS), establishing preventive-maintenance programmes or structured reliability improvement.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

Supporting managers and employees: Be the first point of contact for HR questions, including probation, performance management, leave and terminations. Work with data from HR reports to spot trends and define follow-up actions. Process improvement: Document HR processes and policies in Confluence, identify manual steps and friction points, and implement improvements. Benefits administration: Administer employee benefits such as pension schemes, health and fitness benefits and the learning budget, and coordinate with providers across our locations. AI & Tooling: Contribute to making us faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, n8n). About you We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role: Solid People Operations experience in a high-growth, fast-paced, international environment. Strong execution skills in core HR operations, with hands-on experience in employment contracts and payroll preparation. Strong German, UK, and NL labor law knowledge. Experience with an HRIS, preferably Personio. Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them). Fluent in English and German (C1 minimum). In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for: Reliable executor: you deliver contracts and payroll inputs accurately and on time, and you care about getting the details right. Trustworthy and credible: you handle sensitive data and situations with full confidentiality and build relationships based on a desire to help and support. Adaptive communication: you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and you adjust your style from new joiners to senior leaders. About Moss Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work. Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star. We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect: Top-of-market compensation package, including equity. Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos. Incident management & reliability

  • Drive down how often incidents happen, how long it takes us to notice them, and how long it takes to fix them, with a focus on catching problems with monitors instead of by chance

  • Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvements, and make sure follow-up actions actually get done

  • Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster

  • Champion a culture of blameless incident handling and continuous improvement

Observability & production confidence

  • Advance our Datadog-based observability practice — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting

  • Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue

  • Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist

Change confidence & release quality

  • Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing

  • Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them

  • Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation

  • Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

Platform enablement

  • Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default

  • Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene

  • Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices

  • Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities

  • Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience

  • Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective

  • Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale

  • Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams

  • Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology

  • Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work

  • You work well across teams and raise standards through partnership

  • Communicates in clear, concise English: you listen to understand, adapt to your audience, and make sure people know what to do next

  • Positive, proactive team player who is passionate about operational excellence and who helps others deliver

What sets you apart

  • You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to

  • You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises

  • You have embedded operational excellence practices into the culture of product engineering teams, not just platform teams

  • You have helped teams cut or avoid cost through technical or operational improvements

  • You have driven AI adoption beyond yourself: workflows you built are relied on by others and visibly changed how they work

Incident management & reliability

Observability & production confidence

  • Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

raw.title: Principal AI Engineer (x/f/m)
raw.description:
We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join the Practice Efficiency team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to define and deliver how AI transforms the daily work of healthcare professionals — through intelligent scheduling, automated document processing, smart task management, and AI-assisted patient communication. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will own the deepest technical challenges within the Practice Efficiency scope: setting the AI architecture bar, driving rigorous evaluation standards, and directly shaping how AI-powered features reach healthcare professionals and their patients at scale — starting with the Phone Assistant, currently one of Doctolib's most strategic product bets.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own end-to-end AI architecture decisions for Practice Efficiency — from model selection and agentic system design to production deployment patterns,, and strategic build vs. buy calls

  • Architect and deliver agentic applications at scale, defining how Practice Efficiency AI features are structured, evaluated, and iterated on in production

  • Design robust, scalable AI infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimisation, and observability — enabling the team to ship reliably and fast

  • Lead the technical delivery of the Phone Assistant's AI capabilities, balancing ambitious product ambitions with engineering rigour and production reliability

  • Ensure responsible AI delivery in a regulated healthcare context, embedding explainability, GDPR/HDS compliance, and human-in-the-loop design across all Practice Efficiency AI features

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into sound technical decisions, acting as a bridge between engineering depth and product delivery

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on building AI products — including experience building AI systems before the rise of large language models, giving you strong fundamentals in evaluation, data pipelines, and system design under uncertainty

  • Have a strong background in building and operating large-scale distributed systems — we value deep systems engineering expertise and will consider profiles who bring exceptional scale experience alongside a solid grounding in AI

  • Have hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic applications, with a clear understanding of the challenges around reliability, observability, and evaluation in production agentic systems

  • Are product-centric by nature: you have worked closely with Product Managers and product organisations, bring genuine business sense and customer closeness, and see yourself as part of the product delivery chain — not just the technical one

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, or automatic speech recognition in production environments

  • Have built AI products in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated domain where safety and auditability are non-negotiable

  • Have contributed to or built shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack in this product area is Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React in the monolith, Kotlin for new services, with Postgres, Redis and Kafka underneath.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design Interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • Engineering Manager Case

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Kotlin

  • Full-time

  • Location: Berlin

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany | France | Italy | Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.</p> <p>We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.</p> <p>You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.</p> <p>We joined Hims &amp; Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.</p> <p>We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.</p> <p>We hope that's you.</p></div><p class="p1"><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p class="p2">We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will help our UK business understand performance, make better decisions and improve how quickly we learn. You'll work directly with leaders across Growth, Product, Operations and Finance, owning important commercial questions from problem framing through diagnosis, recommendation and measurement.</p> <p class="p3">This isn't primarily a reporting role. We want someone who notices when something changes, works out why, and helps the business act. You'll also turn recurring questions into reliable, reusable analytical capabilities, contributing to our move towards proactive monitoring, automated diagnosis and trusted self-service insights. You'll collaborate with analytics colleagues across Eucalyptus and Hims &amp; Hers while remaining close to UK business priorities.</p> <p class="p3"><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1"><strong>Diagnose performance. </strong>Investigate movements in acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue. Validate the signal, quantify the drivers, distinguish correlation from causation, and identify the controllable levers behind the change.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Drive decisions. </strong>Work backwards from commercial objectives, challenge assumptions and turn ambiguous questions into focused analysis. Recommend concrete actions, explain trade-offs and follow up to establish whether the decision worked.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Measure impact. </strong>Design and evaluate experiments, launches and operational changes. Use statistical reasoning, cohort analysis and appropriate causal methods to make credible claims, including when evidence is incomplete.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Build repeatable capabilities. </strong>Turn frequent investigations into trusted metrics, models, monitoring, diagnostic workflows and self-service tools. Help strengthen shared definitions and reusable approaches across markets rather than rebuilding the same analysis repeatedly.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Work AI-natively. </strong>Use AI to accelerate exploration, coding, validation and repetitive investigation, and help develop increasingly automated analytical workflows. Maintain ownership of assumptions, evidence and correctness: faster answers only matter when they can be trusted.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Ship and learn quickly. </strong>Deliver useful intermediate answers early, make uncertainty visible, seek stakeholder feedback and iterate. Balance speed with rigour rather than waiting for a polished, one-off analysis.</li> <li class="p2"><strong>Raise the analytical bar. </strong>Review work constructively, share methods openly, question weak conclusions and contribute to a team culture of curiosity, clarity and high standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you</strong></p> <ul> <li class="p1"><strong>Strong foundations. </strong>Around 5+ years in analytics, ideally in a consumer, subscription, e-commerce or digital business. Advanced SQL and practical Python skills; comfortable with complex datasets, modelling and analytical validation.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Commercial and analytical judgment. </strong>You can structure messy problems, identify what matters to the business and separate meaningful drivers from noise. You know when further precision is worth the time.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Sound measurement. </strong>Experience with funnels, cohorts, experimentation and statistical inference. You understand the limits of observational data and communicate confidence and uncertainty accurately.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Ownership and influence. </strong>You independently lead important analyses, build productive relationships with senior stakeholders and communicate recommendations clearly, including when you need to challenge the prevailing view.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Systems mindset. </strong>You look for patterns in repeated requests and create durable solutions. Experience with semantic metrics, BI or data modelling is valuable; you do not need to be a platform engineer.</li> <li class="p1"><strong>Curiosity about AI. </strong>You already use or actively explore AI-assisted workflows and can explain both where they create leverage and where human judgment and verification remain essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What success looks like in your first six months</strong></p> <ul> <li>Become a trusted analytical partner to UK stakeholders and independently own material commercial questions</li> <li>Deliver evidence-backed diagnoses that lead to clear actions, with impact or follow-up measurement</li> <li>Improve the reliability or usability of a core UK metric, model or analytical workflow</li> <li>Replace at least one recurring manual investigation with a reusable, appropriately validated capability</li> <li>Demonstrate faster learning cycles through early delivery, iteration and thoughtful use of AI tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why join us?</strong><br><br>You'll work on consequential problems spanning patient journeys, growth, retention and healthcare operations, with the autonomy to influence decisions and the support of a global analytics organisation. We're actively evolving the craft of analytics: improving foundations, shortening the path from signal to action and building tools that let people answer better questions at scale. You'll help shape that evolution through practical work, not just presentations.<br><br>We welcome candidates from different backgrounds and can discuss reasonable adjustments during recruitment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Sell something worth selling. We're growing massively year on year, and the money we move is a lifeline: remittances pay for school fees, medical bills, rent and food back home. That’s without even mentioning what the next phase of our growth looks like…

Is this you?

You've recruited for senior, niche, executive, or tricky, generalist business and core functions roles at a startup or scale-up, in-house or agency, and closed strong candidates - seriously, top 1% - in competitive markets.

You're a sales-forward recruiter: you'd rather go and find the person who isn't looking than wait for them to apply. You love getting under someone’s skin, understanding what makes them tick - what they want next - and figuring out how to make it a reality for them.

You've hired for scrappy businesses without thousands of predefined processes, and kept your hiring managers on side the whole way.

And… you can have hard conversations with a stakeholder - not just ‘no’, but exactly why and what next. In other words - you’re a real business partner and not a CV shuffler.

Still feeling proud of closing a game changing search that everyone else gave up on? Apply with your CV. We weigh judgment and craft well above years served.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><strong>Role</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>We are looking for a Principal Tech Marketing Engineer to join our team. Bridging product engineering, go-to-market teams, and customers, you will translate complex sovereign cloud architectures—including data residency, operational sovereignty, air-gapped deployments, and regulatory compliance—into clear technical positioning, hands-on demonstrations, and reference architectures.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build reference architectures, deployment guides, white papers, and technical blogs tailored to sovereign cloud providers, public sector agencies, and regulated enterprises</li> <li>Train sales engineers, solutions architects, and ecosystem or channel partners on sovereign cloud positioning, competitive differentiation, and technical objections</li> <li>Deliver technical sessions at conferences and webinars, and assist field teams with technical RFPs and deep-dive customer architecture reviews</li> <li>Partner with product management and engineering to share field insights, compliance requirements, and customer feedback that shape product roadmaps</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and never stop developing yourself, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate.</li> <li>You are customer-obsessed. You build deep empathy for the customer—both internal and external—and anchor your decisions in solving their real-world problems.</li> <li>You champion simplicity. You are skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, simple, and actionable plans.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving</li> <li>Practical understanding of cloud security, data residency/sovereignty controls, access isolation, and regulatory or compliance requirements</li> <li>Strong hands-on background in cloud infrastructure, virtualization, containers, or Kubernetes, plus familiarity with hybrid, on-premises, or sovereign/regulated cloud environments</li> <li>Proven ability to explain complex technical designs to both technical practitioners and business or compliance stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency</li> <li>Prior experience as a Technical Marketing Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Sales Engineer in enterprise cloud, AI infrastructure, networking, or security</li> <li>Experience working with ecosystem partners, hyperscalers, or hardware/software vendors on joint solutions</li> </ul> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-MM8</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-pm-slice="1 3 []">At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. title: Engineering Manager - Grafana Infrastructure (Remote, UK)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><div class="posting-editor"> <div class="postings-description preview"> <p class="section page-centered" style="text-align: left;"><em>This is a remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK, Spain or Ireland.</em></p> <div class="section-wrapper"> <h2>The Opportunity</h2> <h3>About our platform</h3> <p>Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores this data, and serves it to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and do it efficiently and securely.</p> <p>The Foundations department owns the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP): the Kubernetes clusters, cloud service provider resources (CSP), hardware, identity, delivery, and observability systems that Grafana Labs's application engineers use to build, deploy, and run their workloads.</p> <h3>About the Infrastructure group</h3> <p>We're hiring an engineering manager for the Foundations Infrastructure group, which owns the cloud infrastructure Grafana Cloud runs on. The group provisions and operates Kubernetes clusters and CSP resources across GCP, AWS, and Azure; enforces identity, access, and security controls across those environments; and runs the observability and cost-visibility systems that keep the infrastructure measurable and accountable.</p> <p>You'll lead one of the squads of platform engineers that comprise the group.</p> <p>We're platform engineers, and our application teams are our users. Our job is to give them leverage: self-service building blocks that take care of the hard parts of infrastructure, so they can focus on what they're building. We treat the platform as a product and value the experience of the people who use it. When a change is well communicated and understood, teams welcome it, and it lands as an improvement that makes the right way the easy way. You'll lead a squad that makes that happen.</p> <h3>How we work</h3> <p>Foundations is a global team that works asynchronously. We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL) Engineering team, reporting to the BNPL Lead Software Engineer. The team builds and runs the BNPL products our business clients offer their customers and grows the volume of lending that flows through them.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You'll own features end to end, from shaping requirements with product managers and clients through to running them in production. You'll work directly with clients to understand what they need, then build new features, fix issues, and improve what's already running.

We move quickly and value pragmatic technical decisions that balance speed with long-term maintainability. You'll help set that standard for the team through code review, pairing, and mentoring.

What you'll be doing

  • Build the features on our product roadmap that grow lending origination, from new client use cases to a smoother application journey, owning their technical design.

  • Improve how things work and fix issues across our BNPL platform, evolving features as existing clients' needs change and helping new partners get live.

  • Turn ambiguous requirements from product managers, clients and internal stakeholders into clear technical plans, and challenge them where it makes the outcome better.

  • Take part in the full software development lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Mentor engineers through code review and pairing and help uphold strong engineering practices across the team.

  • Provide second-line support within business hours, helping to troubleshoot and resolve issues that affect our clients and their customers.

  • Apply strong SQL skills to troubleshoot and improve the performance of data management and retrieval across our Postgres databases.

Who you are

  • Five or more years of professional experience in software engineering

  • Proficient in writing well-structured async Python with type hints and unit tests

  • Experience designing, building and maintaining APIs and backend services, ideally for business clients

  • Confident working directly with clients and non-technical stakeholders to gather requirements and manage expectations

  • Experience maintaining codebases for business-critical systems

  • Strong SQL skills for efficient data management and retrieval

  • Proficient with Git for version control

  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, with experience of at least one of AWS, GCP or Azure

  • Enjoy supporting other engineers and helping a team raise its standards

Knowledge of lending, BNPL or payments products is an advantage

Our technology stack

Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy and Uvicorn), Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker and AWS.

What we offer

At Abound, you'll be part of a culture that values ownership, autonomy, curiosity, and continuous improvement. You'll gain deep exposure to how a fast-growing lending business works and have the space to deliver meaningful change alongside experienced stakeholders.

  • Everyone owns a piece of the company through equity

  • Hybrid working, with 3 days a week in the office

  • 25 days' holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month's paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Employee loan

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together, whether that's a yoga class, a tennis lesson or bouldering

description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline Group Reporting Team 👋 As a fast moving FTSE 250 business, we're looking for an experienced and technically excellent Head of Group Reporting to join us on a permanent basis. This is a senior role at the heart of our external reporting and financial control framework, calling for deep IFRS expertise and the confidence to navigate complex and judgemental accounting areas. It's a role that goes beyond a typical Group Reporting position, suited to someone who thrives in a varied, fast paced environment, is always ready to get involved, and loves learning new things. Our business changes daily, so we need someone who stays close to the operational side of things and can help us respond quickly and effectively. Technical rigour is non-negotiable here. You'll be the go-to person for complex and judgemental accounting questions, expected to research positions thoroughly, form a clear view, and defend it with auditors and advisors, while translating that thinking into clear, accessible communication for senior non-financial stakeholders. You'll also bring commercial awareness, particularly around cashflow, liquidity and capital, along with the analytical instinct to spot when the numbers don't add up. In this role as the Head of Group Reporting, you will...🚄 Take ownership of producing the Group's IFRS annual and half yearly listed financial statements and annual report. Lead the year end and half year external audit and review processes end to end, keeping key stakeholders informed and preparing and presenting Audit Committee papers. Oversee the production and filing of subsidiary statutory accounts across our UK and international entities. Own the Group's cashflow forecasting process, providing insight and analysis on liquidity, capital allocation and capital structure to support CFO and Board decision making, working closely with treasury on execution. Act as the Group's primary technical accounting authority, researching and forming well reasoned positions on complex and judgemental areas, implementing new standards, and presenting conclusions to senior management, the Audit Committee, auditors and advisors. raw.title: Head of Group Reporting
raw.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Group Reporting Team 👋

As a fast moving FTSE 250 business, we're looking for an experienced and technically excellent Head of Group Reporting to join us on a permanent basis. This is a senior role at the heart of our external reporting and financial control framework, calling for deep IFRS expertise and the confidence to navigate complex and judgemental accounting areas. It's a role that goes beyond a typical Group Reporting position, suited to someone who thrives in a varied, fast paced environment, is always ready to get involved, and loves learning new things. Our business changes daily, so we need someone who stays close to the operational side of things and can help us respond quickly and effectively.

Technical rigour is non-negotiable here. You'll be the go-to person for complex and judgemental accounting questions, expected to research positions thoroughly, form a clear view, and defend it with auditors and advisors, while translating that thinking into clear, accessible communication for senior non-financial stakeholders. You'll also bring commercial awareness, particularly around cashflow, liquidity and capital, along with the analytical instinct to spot when the numbers don't add up.

In this role as the Head of Group Reporting, you will...🚄

  • Take ownership of producing the Group's IFRS annual and half yearly listed financial statements and annual report.

  • Lead the year end and half year external audit and review processes end to end, keeping key stakeholders informed and preparing and presenting Audit Committee papers.

  • Oversee the production and filing of subsidiary statutory accounts across our UK and international entities.

  • Own the Group's cashflow forecasting process, providing insight and analysis on liquidity, capital allocation and capital structure to support CFO and Board decision making, working closely with treasury on execution.

  • Act as the Group's primary technical accounting authority, researching and forming well reasoned positions on complex and judgemental areas, implementing new standards, and presenting conclusions to senior management, the Audit Committee, auditors and advisors.

  • Take the lead on one off projects, partnering with teams across the business, while contributing to monthly reporting, annual budgeting, and ownership of specific balance sheet, cashflow and working capital areas.

  • Build and support strong external relationships, including with auditors, loan providers and banking partners, and work closely with legal and CoSec to ensure reporting requirements are met on time.

  • Lead Finance's contribution to the Group's material controls framework under Provision 29, maintain and develop the Group's accounting policies including for acquisitions and legal structure changes, and guide reporting systems and process change to protect the integrity of our control environment.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • You're a qualified accountant with significant post qualification experience, including meaningful time spent in industry within a listed business, and are comfortable with the reporting obligations and scrutiny that come with that environment; you have a consistent record of delivering to deadline.

  • You bring extensive IFRS expertise and a strong technical accounting grounding, confident researching and forming defensible positions on complex areas such as multi-currency consolidations, share based payments, EPS, impairment, revenue recognition, leases and business combinations.

  • If you're currently in practice, you'd be operating at Director level or above, with substantial experience advising listed groups on complex technical matters and be ready to step into a senior in-house leadership role.

  • You have experience researching and implementing new accounting or reporting standards.

  • You're analytical and thorough when reviewing financial information, quick to spot errors in accounting treatment or anomalies that don't add up.

  • You have proven people management experience, with a track record of leading, motivating and developing high performing teams across multiple disciplines.

  • You're an excellent project manager, organised in your own workload while confident delegating and developing others, equally comfortable working independently or as part of a team.

  • You're ambitious and driven, energised by a fast paced environment, always ready to get involved in team projects and try new things; it would be helpful if you're open to occasional travel to our Paris and Edinburgh offices.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

connaissance des créateurs de contenu et des plateformes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Twitch, Snapchat).</li> <li>Curiosité, créativité, réactivité, rigueur et sens de l’organisation pour d’influence, de la stratégie à la mesure de la performance.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.&nbsp;</p> <p>On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,&nbsp; generating opportunities via outbound outreach.&nbsp;</p> <p>We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.</p> <p><strong>This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You are the architect of your own career: </strong>If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less.</li> <li><strong>You love talking to people: </strong>In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.</li> <li><strong>You treat rejection as a learning experience:</strong> In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara’s mission.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong>Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin</li> <li>Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners.</li> <li>Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling</li> <li>Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com)</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles</li> <li>6-12 months sales experience as a minimum</li> <li>Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales</li> <li>Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, verbal and written</li> <li>Curious and able to ask insightful questions</li> <li>A champion of a Growth Mindset</li> <li>Highly proficient in English and fluent in French</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in closing-sales roles</li> <li>Proven track record of achievements beyond work (e.g. academics, sports, charity, …)</li> <li>Willingness to collaborate and influence in a “win as a team” environment</li> <li>Excitement about solving new problems in innovative ways</li> <li>Motivation to help build a fast-growing business in the IoT and SaaS space</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADR pathways</strong></p> <p>Through Samsara’s ADR program, there are always opportunities to move to the next level and take on more responsibility during the program and beyond—those who work hard to grow quickly will have the opportunity to advance their careers. With emphasis on continued professional development, the training doesn't stop after onboarding—we provide opportunities to expand ADRs’ understanding of the market and our competitors, develop hard skills needed in the Sales function, and work with mentors to help our representatives progress through the three levels of our ADR program.</p> <ul> <li><strong>ADR I</strong> representatives focus on inbound leads—conducting a high volume of conversations, sharing the ins and outs of our products, and fostering relationships with those prospects interested in Samsara. At the ADR I level, we provide plenty of learning opportunities including call sessions with more senior Sales team members, training on tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), product knowledge, objection handling, and more. Our representatives at this level are go-getters who are able to progress their careers through the opportunities provided for them.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>The next level in the program is <strong>ADR II</strong>, where our representatives work on top of funnel movement, creating high quality sales engagements, and supporting our Account Executives. Along with the leap into outbound work, those at the ADR II level are continually exposed to learning opportunities and enrolled in specialized trainings including professional writing, persona based messaging, , cold calling 2.0, and collaboration and communication with Account Executives. description: At Zoomo, our vision is to transition every commercial urban mile to light electric vehicles (LEVs) to build sustainable and more equitable cities. To that end, we are building the world’s most convenient, affordable, and safe e-bike platform. In 4 years Zoomo has helped transition millions of urban miles to light electric vehicles, built a team of >200 world class engineers, operators, sales staff and vehicle repair technicians; developed and deployed the world's best last mile delivery electric bikes and fleet management software; and successfully deploys these solutions around the world. We operate across the USA, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Zoomo vehicles are used by major players in the food, grocery and parcel delivery segments with partners including UberEats, Doordash, JustEat Takeaway, Deliveroo, Domino’s, Pizza Hut, Amazon, FedEx, Getir, Ocado, GoPuff and many more. The Role We’re hiring the most senior leader in France, reporting to the COO, to own market performance end-to-end: operational excellence, growth, and P&L outcomes. You’ll shape and improve our physical operations (fleet, workshop, retail), lead a hands-on team on the ground, and drive pragmatic growth initiatives (pricing, channels, partnerships) to build demand. This role requires an entrepreneurial operator with strong ownership, comfortable both running day-to-day operations and identifying opportunities to improve and grow the business. You can expect to: Drive local growth strategy: identify demand constraints and run pragmatic tests (pricing, offers, channels, local partnerships) with clear measurement. Stabilise and scale core operations (workshop + retail + fleet logistics). Expand capacity thoughtfully as demand grows, ensuring process discipline and cost control. Deliver excellent B2B operations (SLA, onboarding, servicing, reporting) while maintaining focus on B2C growth (majority of the business). Own P&L rhythm for France: budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and trade-offs that protect unit economics while enabling growth. Hire, coach, and performance-manage a high-accountability frontline team; develop 1-2 strong leads to strengthen local leadership depth.  Lead safety initiatives and programs to ensure we continue to keep customers and employees safe at scale. Own the weekly operating cadence and core KPIs for France. Ensure pragmatic processes that keep the operation in control are implemented and digested by the team. Create a high-performance culture: clear ownership, measurable goals, fast problem-solving, and strong talent development. Act as the senior leader in France, partnering with central functions (Ops, Growth, Finance, Revenue, Tech, People) to set priorities, ensure support and deliver results. Handle local ‘GM admin’ with limited support: vendors, facilities topics, contracts coordination, and operational bureaucracy - solve problems end-to-end. Requirements 5+ years of experience managing frontline operations in a fast-paced, physical environment (last-mile, mobility, retail ops, field services, logistics). Proven track record improving measurable outcomes (throughput, quality, cost, availability, customer metrics) via hands-on leadership and process discipline. You have hired and led frontline teams; comfortable with performance management and raising the bar in junior teams. You are an entrepreneurial operator with a high-ownership mindset who thrives in ambiguous, decentralised international environments, proactively building solutions and driving impact without the need for constant direction. You have a bias for action and experimentation: identify levers, run tests (incl. pricing/channel changes), measure impact, iterate fast. Comfortable switching between floor-level detail (workshop/retail) and business planning (forecasting, stakeholder updates). Basic P&L experience: has managed or strongly influenced revenue and cost lines; can budget/forecast and make trade-offs. Comfortable handling administrative complexity and operational bureaucracy; can coordinate vendors/contracts/facilities issues end-to-end. Experience in a scale-up or transformation environment with ambiguity and limited structure; can build order without heavy support. Humility is something that comes naturally to you. You’re a born collaborator and you care about getting to the right answer more than who came up with it. description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! Parallel deploys AI agents directly in hospitals to automate these processes, in one week where a traditional integration takes 12 to 24 months. Private hospital groups are a different story: the first large groups are already live, more are coming, and a new portfolio of private groups is joining us. At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning.

The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it!

Context

Every year, hospitals lose millions because of administrative tasks that are poorly coded, poorly billed or poorly processed, and their teams burn out doing them. Parallel deploys AI agents directly in hospitals to automate these processes, in one week where a traditional integration takes 12 to 24 months. The result: between €100K and €5M in revenue recovered per facility, and clinical teams who get their time back.

Our public sector team is fully staffed. Private hospital groups are a different story: the first large groups are already live, more are coming, and a new portfolio of private groups is joining us. Until now, our founders and ops lead have handled these accounts directly. Now we need someone to own them.

Own the relationship with around thirty of the largest private hospital groups in France (Ramsay, Vivalto and others), and make sure every ongoing deal moves forward and gets delivered.

  • Go meet people: on site at the clinics, over lunch with your champion, at the group’s head office

  • Raise the alarm early: when an account isn’t going the right way, you’re the first to notice and the first to say it

Outcomes

  • Every group in the portfolio has a clear plan, a known champion and visible progress

  • Groups already live expand to more facilities and more products

  • Newly joined groups are onboarded onto SMR, and the first MCO deals are signed

  • Risks are flagged early, before they turn into churn
