Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with Wellhub.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

description: <p>Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable<br><br>Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.<br><br>About the Team<br><br>The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.<br><br>You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.<br><br>Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.<br><br>What You’ll Do</p> <ul> <li>Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.</li> <li>Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.</li> <li>Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.</li> <li>Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.</li> <li>Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.</li> <li>Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.</li> <li>Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.</li> </ul> <p>Who Are You?</p> <ul> <li>First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.</li> <li>You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.</li> <li>You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.</li> <li>You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.</li> <li>You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.</li> <li>You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).</li> <li>You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.</li> </ul> <p>More information?<br><br>Do not hesitate to call Maggie: 06 23 75 70 86.</p> <p><em>Only application submitted through the website will be considered.&nbsp;</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. raw.title: Stagiair Social Media - vtwonen
raw.description:
Amsterdam – Ben jij altijd online en heb je een passie voor wonen, interieur en social media? Tijdens deze allround stage werk je mee aan de online kanalen van vtwonen, vtwonen Landelijk en vtwonen Design en ontwikkel je jezelf binnen een professioneel mediateam. Je krijgt veel ruimte om te leren, mee te denken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Twee keer per jaar zoeken wij een stagiair voor ons online team, die start in februari of september. Lijkt dit je leuk, lees dan snel verder!

Wat ga je doen?
Tijdens deze stage speel je een actieve rol in het beheren en verder ontwikkelen van de socialmediakanalen van vtwonen. Met jouw creativiteit en gevoel voor online content draag je bij aan het vergroten van de betrokkenheid van onze doelgroep en zorg je ervoor dat onze merken dagelijks zichtbaar en relevant blijven. Dit doe je onder andere door:

  • Het beheren van de socialmediakanalen Instagram, TikTok, Facebook en Pinterest voor vtwonen, vtwonen tuin, vtwonen Landelijk en vtwonen Design.

  • Het creëren van aansprekende content in tekst en beeld die aansluit bij de verschillende merken.

  • Het versterken van de relatie met onze online community door middel van communitymanagement.

  • Het analyseren van campagnes en het opstellen van heldere rapportages.

  • Het ondersteunen bij video-opnames, zowel in onze studio in Amsterdam als op locatie.

Daarnaast vinden we het belangrijk dat jouw stage aansluit bij jouw leerdoelen en interesses. In overleg met je stagebegeleider is er ruimte om je verder te verdiepen in onderwerpen die jij belangrijk vindt.

Wie zijn wij?
Wij zijn vtwonen, dé wooncoach voor een fijn en stijlvol thuis dat helemaal bij jou past. Met onze magazines, het televisieprogramma vtwonen Weer verliefd op je huis, eigen collecties, een website, nieuwsbrieven, socialmediakanalen en een eigen vtwonen marketplace inspireren we iedere dag onze doelgroep. Van binnenkijkers en stylingideeën tot DIY-projecten, tuintips en de nieuwste woontrends: vtwonen helpt mensen bij het creëren van een persoonlijke woonstijl.

Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat?

  • Je hebt ervaring met of affiniteit voor social media, interieur en digitale content.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor beeld, tekst en video en bent creatief in het ontwikkelen van content.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: Senior Platform Engineer We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams. The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain.  We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering You will be responsible for: Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices. Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling. Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves. raw.description:
Senior Platform Engineer
We are looking for a passionate and collaborative Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Core team. At Treatwell we follow Team Topologies principles: our platform exists to enable stream-aligned teams to move faster and more autonomously, through self-service capabilities, reliable infrastructure and a great developer experience, built in partnership with our Developer Experience and Data Platform teams.

The Platform Core team provides the foundational infrastructure and tooling that enables Treatwell's engineering organisation to ship value quickly and safely. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will own the ambiguous platform problems nobody has scoped yet. You will shape them with the team before they become work, design solutions at service level and make the technical calls in your domain. 

We want product teams to experience Platform Core as a strategic partner: a trusted advisor involved early, not a ticket resolver. We deliver value in small increments, own outcomes together with the teams we support, and measure success by the impact we enable across Engineering

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning core platform capabilities (AWS and GCP foundations, identity and access, networking and the AI layer on Bedrock), from ambiguous problems to production, delivered in small slices.
  • Design delivery and operation of our EKS platform in partnership with DevX, including upgrades, add-ons and autoscaling.
  • Building self-service tooling, such as OpenTofu pipelines and GitLab CI/CD components, so teams can provision infrastructure themselves.
  • Running GitLab and other shared platform services: upgrades, patching, monitoring and recovery.
  • Making sure every platform change goes through a reviewed pipeline.
  • Making and owning the technical decisions in your domain, using spikes to test options and escalating early when needed.
  • Commanding platform incidents, and following through on post-mortems.
  • Improving the security of the services you own, in line with the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
  • Using AI tools in your daily work and helping others do the same.
  • Mentoring engineers, giving useful feedback.
  • Shaping engineering standards through our guilds
  • Partnering with product teams early, understanding their plans before they need us, and making Platform Core easy to work with.
  • Aligning teams on approach before work starts, and explaining trade-offs in terms of risk and value.
  • Using platform metrics and support data to argue for what to do next, and shaping new work with your team before it is defined

About you

  • Several years in platform, infrastructure, with clear ownership of production platforms used by other engineering teams.
  • Deep hands-on Terraform (or OpenTofu) on AWS, including module design and multi-account or multi-tenant setups.
  • Expert with Kubernetes (EKS) and containers; experience running cluster upgrades and Helm or Kustomize at scale.
  • Strong in GitLab CI and designing reusable pipelines and templates for many teams.
  • Professional depth in core AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, Route53, CloudFront, S3, RDS, EKS). GCP exposure is a bonus.
  • Experience with, or strong interest in, modern cloud networking such as AWS VPC Lattice and service mesh with support for identity-based access between services
  • Fluent in Bash and Python for automation; comfortable on Linux 
  • Practical observability experience with Datadog, Prometheus, CloudWatch or Grafana, including defining SLIs and alerting.
  • Security-minded: IAM least privilege, secrets management, container supply-chain security, and applying the AWS Well-Architected Framework and DSOMM.
  • Experience leading production incidents and making technical decisions you own, including when they turn out wrong.
  • Have grown other engineers and can explain complex trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

We’ll treat you with:

  • 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays
  • Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too
  • Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process

Equal Opportunities

Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application.

description: <h3><strong>Senior Mechatronic System Architect | Medical Robotics (m/f/d)</strong></h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> CTO</p> <p><strong>About the venture: ROB'E</strong></p> <p>ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.</p> <p>Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality &amp; Regulatory.</p> <p><strong>The role</strong></p> <p>You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot. You work on site with our engineering development partner in the Maastricht area and steer their team on our behalf. This is a hands-on senior role: you design yourself, review the work of others and make sure the hardware is safe, verifiable and ready for design transfer.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and own the mechatronic system architecture: robotic device, drives, force and torque sensing, real-time controllers, safety supervisor, power supply and the interface to commercial TEE probes.</li> <li>Translate user and system requirements into subsystem and interface specifications and keep them traceable through verification.</li> <li>Act as technical counterpart to our engineering development partner, from ideation, technology and part selection through design reviews and approval of design outputs. Challenge cost and effort and make the make-or-buy call per subsystem.</li> <li>Work closely with the System Software Architect on the hardware/software split, real-time control, and safety architecture.</li> <li>Drive the hardware contribution to risk management (ISO 14971), including design FMEA and risk control measures.</li> <li>Plan and lead hardware verification, pre-compliance and full compliance testing for electrical safety and EMC (IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2) with external test houses.</li> <li>Contribute hardware documentation to the design history file and technical documentation under our ISO 13485 quality system.</li> <li>Build prototypes for verification, usability studies and clinical evaluation, together with suppliers and the development partner.</li> <li>Design for cost and manufacturability from the start and prepare the transfer to series production.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you bring</strong></p> <p><strong>Must have</strong></p> <ul> <li>MSc or PhD in mechatronics, mechanical, electrical or systems engineering.</li> <li>At least 8 years of hardware development experience, including at least 3 years as a system architect or lead engineer.</li> <li>Hands-on development of active medical devices through design controls, from concept to verified design.</li> <li>Practical experience with IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2 and ISO 14971, and working knowledge of ISO 13485 and MDR.</li> <li>Strong background in motion systems: drives, transmissions, encoders, force/torque sensing and motion safety.</li> <li>Experience steering external engineering partners or suppliers, including technical reviews and cost control.</li> <li>Fluent in English and comfortable working in a small, fast moving startup team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with medical robotics, catheter or endoscope handling, or image guided intervention systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of cleanable and reprocessable device design and single use interface components.</li> <li>Dutch or German language skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>A key role in a clinically validated medtech venture, with real influence on the product and the company.</li> <li>Close collaboration with interventional cardiologists and direct exposure to the cath lab.</li> <li>Permanent employment with a competitive salary We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

 

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our Risk team as a Credit and Financial Risk Manager?

Reporting to the Chief Risk Officer, you will lead independent second-line oversight of ClearBank's lending and financial risk activities. As a senior risk leader and recognised subject-matter expert, you will translate Risk strategy into business-critical delivery, shape appetite, policy, controls and governance, and influence material decisions across ClearBank Europe and the wider Group. You will provide authoritative challenge, anticipate emerging issues, lead complex remediation and recovery activity, and strengthen organisational capability while enabling sustainable growth.

 

Your role includes:

  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge across the design, approval, launch and ongoing management of lending products, ensuring material risks are understood, controlled and aligned with approved appetite.

  • Own the second-line review and challenge of complex or material credit proposals, portfolio strategies and periodic reviews, providing clear recommendations to senior decision-makers and governance committees.

  • Set the second-line approach to non-performing and vulnerable exposures, leading complex recovery strategies, senior stakeholder engagement, escalation and resolution to minimise losses and protect ClearBank's interests.

  • Shape and maintain the policy, appetite, control and governance framework across the credit lifecycle, partnering with model validation and other specialists to ensure credit risk and provisioning models remain robust and fit for purpose.

  • Provide senior oversight of financial risks, including asset and liability, liquidity and interest-rate risk, connecting risk assessments across disciplines and anticipating emerging balance-sheet vulnerabilities.

  • Lead complex, cross-functional risk initiatives with potential enterprise application, translating strategy and regulatory expectations into practical improvements across ClearBank Europe and the wider ClearBank Group.

What does success in this role look like:

You will:

  • Maintain a high-quality lending portfolio that enables sustainable growth within risk appetite.

  • Deliver forward-looking credit and financial risk insight that improves senior and committee decisions.

  • Resolve complex and emerging risks issues, including non-performing exposures, through decisive intervention, recovery and escalation.

  • Shape scalable policies, appetite, controls and governance for growth and regulatory change.

  • Act as a recognised expert and trusted adviser, influencing senior stakeholders through expertise, sound judgement and constructive challenge.

  • Align functions on competing priorities, ownership and enterprise risk outcomes.

  • Build capability through coaching, delegation and knowledge sharing.

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Extensive experience leading second-line challenge of complex credit risk in regulated financial services.

  • A track record of launching and scaling credit products within robust risk governance.

  • Advanced expertise in institutional lending, portfolios, problem exposures and risk drivers.

  • Strong knowledge of liquidity, interest-rate and asset-and-liability risk.

  • Ability to lead complex work independently and improve risk outcomes.

  • Exceptional analytical and communication skills, with credibility among senior stakeholders and committees.

  • Leadership experience in coaching, setting standards and creating accountability.

 

What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?

  • You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank.

  • You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care.

  • You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate.

  • ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary.

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

What we offer in return:

  • We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.

  • Offices – Work in a way that works for you, combining working from our Amsterdam office with working from home.

  • Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus public holidays.

  • Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.

  • Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the Netherlands for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.

  • Socials – Regular social events open to all.

  • Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.

  • Wellbeing – long term disability cover and accident cover.

  • Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.

  • Pension – We offer generous pension contribution without mandatory employee contribution.

  • Expense coverage – Mobile phone allowance and travel cost reimbursement.

  • Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.

  • Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

Role level: 5

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!

title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.   Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands . Wat bieden wij jou? Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer. Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform.

Jouw rol

Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.

  • Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.

  • Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.

  • Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.

  • Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.

title: Account Director, Public Sector (DACH)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Netherlands. We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. You will also strengthen existing accounts, drive renewals and expansions, and build a strong network of customer advocates. This is an opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission at the intersection of AI, cryptocurrency, and national security within a fast-paced, international environment. Accountabilities: As an Account Director, Public Sector, you will own the development and execution of sales strategies across your assigned territory, building trusted relationships with government customers and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your key responsibilities will include: Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region. Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities. Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals. Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities. Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion. Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers. Deliver compelling presentations and value propositions that demonstrate how solutions can help customers investigate and disrupt criminal activities. Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams. raw.description:

Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including  Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 


The Opportunity
We’re looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong AWS and cloud security expertise to join our global Infrastructure Operations team.
 
You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams.
 
You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to solve infrastructure challenges, improve reliability and cut down manual work through automation.

What You'll Do
  • Design, build and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions
  • Manage infrastructure as code and improve our CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments
    Strengthen AWS security with controls and policies across the organization, plus well designed IAM and network security rules
  • Spot and fix security risks, misconfigurations and vulnerabilities, working closely with our Security team on reviews, investigations and remediation
  • Improve monitoring, logging and alerting so teams can catch and resolve issues faster
  • Automate repetitive tasks and make it easier for developers to self serve their infrastructure needs
  • Keep our platforms reliable, performant and cost efficient, including taking part in on call rotations, troubleshooting production incidents and preventing them from happening again
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams, share what you know and help shape technical decisions

    • What You'll Bring
  • 5+ years in infrastructure operations, cloud, platform engineering or DevOps, with at least 3 of those years working on AWS
  • Hands on experience with core AWS services like EC2, ECS, Lambda, RDS, VPC, Route 53 and CloudFront, including managing multiple accounts through AWS Organizations
  • Confident with Terraform or a similar Infrastructure as Code tool, plus building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong grasp of AWS security, including IAM, access across accounts, SCPs, RCPs and network security, along with auditing tools like CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty or Security Hub
  • Solid networking knowledge, including VPC, routing, firewalls, VPN and private connectivity
  • Comfortable with Linux, scripting in Python or Bash, and containers using Docker, ECS or Kubernetes
  • Familiar with monitoring tools like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry, with strong troubleshooting skills and a collaborative way of working across engineering teams
  • It’s a plus if you’ve worked with security automation tools like Cloud Custodian, Checkov or Trivy, know standards such as PCI DSS or the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, have experience with high traffic distributed systems or payment platforms, or hold an AWS certification like Security Specialty, Solutions Architect or Advanced Networking
